crossRefs.keyword: Lo-ammi. that is, Not my people

people.name: Lo-ammi
people.line: Symbolic name of Hosea's son; represents God's rejection of Israel

translations.web: He said, “Call his name Lo-Ammi; for you are not my people, and I will not be yours.
translations.bsb: And the LORD said, “Name him Lo-ammi, for you are not My people, and I am not your God.
translations.kjv: Then said God, Call his name Loammi: for ye are not my people,
translations.asv: And Jehovah said, Call his name Lo-ammi; for ye are not my people, and I will not be your God.
